landing.hero_title: Finance your projects with peace of mind.
landing.hero_subtitle: We negotiate your eco loan with 30+ partner banks. You compare the best offers. And you sign.
landing.how_title: From simulation to signature, in 3 steps.
landing.how_subtitle: No unnecessary paperwork, no jargon. A human advisor, a clear platform.
landing.step1_text: Adjust the sliders for your project. You see your monthly payment and borrowing capacity in 30 seconds. Free, anonymous.
landing.step2_text: 2 minutes to create your account. A dedicated advisor calls you back within 24h to frame your financing project.
landing.step3_text: We put together your file and present it to our 30+ partner banks. You compare the offers, you sign the best one.
landing.how_bottom_title: A few days later: your loan validated, at the best rate.
landing.how_bottom_text: We defend your file with our partner banks. You compare the offers, you sign the one that suits you.
landing.client_title: A space designed for your file.
landing.client_subtitle: We build your file properly and defend it with our 30+ partner banks. You follow the progress at your own pace.
landing.client_feature1_desc: European hosting, TLS encryption, access only to your advisor.
landing.client_feature2_desc: Your advisor calls you back within 24h and stays by your side from start to finish. Reachable by email for any question.
landing.client_feature3_desc: You know where your file stands at each stage — Profile, Documents, Study, Offers.
landing.client_feature4_desc: We present your profile to our 30+ banks and negotiate up to the best offer.
landing.review_0_text: "We saved €18,000 in interest over 25 years thanks to their negotiation. Great advisor, super responsive from start to finish."
landing.review_1_text: "As first-time buyers, we were lost. Everything was clearly explained, we signed in 6 weeks."
landing.review_2_text: "Rental investment, tough case. They found a bank that accepted in 10 days. Mind blown."
landing.review_3_text: "The simulator gave me a clear idea right away. The advisor did the rest, almost effortlessly on my part."
landing.review_4_text: "Rejected twice by my historic bank. Accepted in 3 weeks with them, at a better rate. Thanks."
landing.review_5_text: "The client portal is super well done. You know exactly where your file is, no need to follow up with the broker every morning."
